title: Offseason Commissioner Content Creation
user_story: As a League Commissioner, I want to create and publish custom content during the offseason (when no active matchups exist), so that I can maintain league engagement year-round with recaps, awards, draft preparation content, and preseason previews.
problem_statement: Current system assumes active fantasy season with matchup-driven content. Offseason periods (weeks with no external fantasy data) lack flexible content creation tools. Commissioners need ability to create standalone content without matchup context, handle preseason week numbering differently, and maintain historical narrative during non-competitive periods.

business_value.user_engagement: Maintain league engagement during 6+ month offseason periods
business_value.retention: Reduce league abandonment between seasons with year-round content
business_value.differentiation: Unique offseason content capabilities not available in standard fantasy platforms
business_value.commissioner_satisfaction: Enable creative storytelling beyond week-to-week game results

criteria: GIVEN commissioner accesses content editor during offseason (no active NFL week)
WHEN selecting 'Create Content' option
THEN system provides 'Offseason Content' template with fields: Title, Content Type (Recap/Awards/Preview/Custom), Season Reference (YYYY), Custom Week Label (optional), Body Text, Media Attachments
AND system does NOT require matchup selection or external fantasy data connection
AND content is tagged as 'offseason' in metadata
GIVEN commissioner creates content for preseason weeks (NFL weeks 1-3 of calendar year)
WHEN assigning week number to content
THEN system automatically prefixes with 'Preseason Week X' label in UI
AND historical views distinguish preseason weeks with visual badge/icon
AND week selectors show 'Preseason Weeks 1-3' as separate category from 'Regular Season Weeks 1-17'
AND API responses include 'season_type' field ('preseason' | 'regular' | 'playoff' | 'offseason')
GIVEN commissioner selects offseason content type
WHEN choosing from predefined templates

THEN system provides: 'Season Recap' (full season summary), 'League Awards' (MVP, championships, records), 'Draft Preview' (player rankings, strategies), 'Offseason Moves' (keeper decisions, trades), 'Custom Article' (freeform)
AND each template includes suggested structure but allows full customization
AND media library supports unlimited image/video attachments without matchup context
AND content can reference multiple seasons/years for historical comparisons
GIVEN commissioner creates offseason content
WHEN selecting publish options
THEN system allows: Immediate Publish, Schedule for Future Date, Save as Draft
AND content respects league visibility settings (public leagues show offseason content to guests)
AND RSS feeds include offseason content with appropriate season/week metadata
AND notification system sends alerts to league members for new offseason posts
GIVEN offseason content is published
WHEN viewing league history or timeline
THEN offseason content appears in chronological order between seasons
AND filtering options include 'Show Offseason Content' toggle (default: ON)
AND season navigation UI clearly delineates season boundaries (e.g., '2023 Season Recap' between '2023 Playoffs' and '2024 Preseason')
AND search functionality indexes offseason content with season tags
GIVEN commissioner attempts to create content without specifying season reference
WHEN submitting offseason content form
THEN system displays error: 'Season reference required for offseason content. Please select a year.'
AND form highlights missing 'Season Reference' field in red
AND provides auto-suggestion based on most recent completed season
GIVEN commissioner assigns week number to preseason content
WHEN week number conflicts with existing regular season weeks (e.g., 'Week 1' already exists for regular season)
THEN system prevents submission with error: 'Week number conflicts with regular season. Use preseason-specific numbering or custom labels.'
AND provides option to auto-convert to 'Preseason Week X' format
AND displays preview of how week label will appear in UI
GIVEN league transitions from playoffs to offseason (no active matchups)
WHEN commissioner accesses content editor immediately after season end
THEN system automatically detects offseason state (no external fantasy data for current week)
AND displays prominent banner: 'Offseason Mode Active - Create recaps, awards, and preview content'
AND provides quick-start wizard for common offseason content types
AND maintains access to previous season's matchup-based content for reference

acceptance_criteria.description: Edge Case: Multiple Offseason Posts Same Week
criteria: GIVEN commissioner creates multiple offseason posts for same custom week (e.g., 'Draft Day')
WHEN publishing multiple posts with identical week labels
THEN system allows multiple posts (no uniqueness constraint on offseason weeks)
AND sorts posts by publish timestamp within same week
AND provides optional sub-numbering in UI (e.g., 'Draft Day - Post 1 of 3')
AND RSS feed includes all posts in chronological order

database_schema: Add 'season_reference_year' INTEGER column for offseason content (nullable for regular season)
Add 'custom_week_label' VARCHAR(50) column for flexible week naming
Modify uniqueness constraints to allow multiple offseason posts per week
Add indexes on 'season_type' and 'season_reference_year' for efficient queries
api_changes: Update POST /commissioner-content to accept offseason-specific fields
Modify week selector API to return preseason weeks separately
Add GET /commissioner-content/offseason endpoint for offseason-only content
ui_components: Add 'SeasonTypeBadge' component for visual distinction in lists
Create 'OffseasonWizard' component for quick-start content creation
external_dependencies: No external fantasy data API calls for offseason content
Ensure media upload service handles offseason content without matchup IDs
Verify notification service supports offseason content alerts

relates_to: US-4.4 (Content history and editing - offseason content must integrate with history views)
US-1.4 (League visibility settings - offseason content respects public/private rules)

unit_tests: Test offseason content creation without matchup context
Verify season_type field validation and storage
Test preseason week numbering logic and display formatting
Verify custom week label handling and uniqueness constraints
integration_tests: Test full offseason content workflow: create -> publish -> view
Verify transition between regular season and offseason modes
Test multiple offseason posts with same week label
Verify historical integration (offseason content appears in timeline)
edge_case_tests: Test creating offseason content immediately after season ends
Verify behavior when external fantasy API returns no data (offseason detection)
Test preseason week numbering conflicts with regular season
Test offseason content with season_reference_year spanning multiple years
accessibility_tests: Verify screen readers announce season_type badges correctly
Test keyboard navigation in offseason content wizard
Verify color contrast for preseason/offseason visual indicators

performance: Offseason content creation completes in <500ms (no external API calls)
Historical views load offseason content with <100ms incremental overhead
Week selector renders preseason/offseason sections in <200ms
security: Only league commissioners can create offseason content (role-based access control)
Offseason content respects league visibility settings (RLS policies apply)
XSS protection for custom week labels and freeform content
usability: Offseason content wizard reduces creation time by 60% vs manual form entry
Preseason week labels clearly distinguish from regular season (visual differentiation)
Error messages provide actionable guidance for season/week conflicts

definition_of_done: All 9 acceptance criteria pass automated tests
Offseason content creation works without external fantasy API dependency
Preseason weeks display with correct numbering and visual badges
Multiple offseason posts with same week label function correctly
Offseason content integrates seamlessly into historical timeline views
Documentation updated with offseason content creation guide
Commissioner feedback collected on offseason template usefulness
notes: Key gap: Current system assumes active season with matchup data. Offseason periods (6+ months/year) lack flexible content tools.
Preseason numbering distinction critical for user clarity (Preseason Week 1 vs Regular Season Week 1)
Custom week labels enable creative content (e.g., 'Draft Day', 'Trade Deadline Recap', 'End of Season Awards')
Historical integration ensures offseason content doesn't create timeline gaps
No external API dependency for offseason content improves performance and reliability
